# cp437-8x16.bin

8x16 CP437 font, 256 glyphs x 16 bytes (row 0 first, bit 7 = leftmost pixel),
Terminus-derived, built by the owner's hardweb project
(`~/Projects/hardweb/assets/fonts/hardweb-cp437-8x16.bin`, see
README-hardweb.md). Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL-1.1.txt).
`scripts/font_bin_to_vhdl.py` generates `hdl/src/video/font8x16_pkg.vhd`.
